scoring.acceptance: Average reserve > 1.0, with Test passed and success exit status

scoring.printed_boundary: Reserve prints six decimal places; use verdict or unrounded statistic for strict boundary.
scoring.performance: Streamed Total time (ms.), lower is better; Options per sec. is derived
